description: Cảnh mới hiện trong một hình có nghĩa (trái tim, ổ khoá, ngôi sao) phóng từ 0 tới phủ kín khung.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tr-shapeiris, written here): Incoming scene clipped to a shape centred on the frame, scale 0 -> cover (until the shape clears every corner; ~7 x a heart 16 % of frame width) over 700 ms easeInCubic. Use a polygon clip (KI-03: clip-path path() fails in After Effects). HF showcase-radial ships a Diamond Iris. Params: shape (trái tim) · duration (0.7 s) · ease (power2.in).
